Post Text:
Hi everyone! Hope you?re all doing well.

I have been thinking about a few things lately, made some decisions, and honestly I?d really like to hear your suggestions.

I started freelancing in 2021, directly through Upwork. I got my first project that same year while I was still doing my graduation.

By 2026, I?ve earned $25K+ through Upwork. In 2024 alone, I made around $16K from just one client, so overall it has been a really valuable journey for me.

My degree is BS Business Administration, with a specialization in Finance. But the interesting part is that I honestly didn?t do a single proper project on Upwork that was directly related to my degree or field ??

Most of my actual work has been around:

? Travel planning, hotel research & trip planning
? Market and company research
? Company outreach and negotiation
? Interview/survey research
? Finding hard-to-find information using different tools and methods, including Wayback Machine
? Data analysis
? Around 1.5 years of working with a California-based attorney on legal research and investigation research for different cases
? Product/manufacturer sourcing from China to the USA and other countries
? Working with 3 different YouTube channels for research/content support, including 2 travel documentary channels

So basically, over these 5?6 years, I?ve done a lot of different things. I never really stayed within one specialized field.

And maybe that was my strength before, but now I?m starting to feel that it may also be a weakness.

In 2026, the market feels very different. AI has obviously changed a lot of research, data entry, basic VA and similar work. Competition is much higher, and finding good projects doesn?t feel as easy as it used to.

Now I?m seriously thinking about what I should do next.

One mistake I think I made was relying too much on a single source of income. Upwork has been my major source for years.

I?m now thinking about moving more toward technology and AI, but there?s one problem:

I don?t come from a tech background.

So if I start moving toward AI/tech now, what should I actually learn?

AI automation?
AI tools?
Data/analytics?
No-code/low-code?
AI agents?
Cloud/Azure?
Or should I combine my existing research/business experience with AI?

I?m not saying I?m completely quitting Upwork, but I do feel that I need a second direction and a more sustainable long-term skill or business.

So I?d genuinely appreciate some honest advice, especially from people working in freelancing, business, tech or AI.

If you were in my position in 2026, with this kind of experience but without a technical background, which direction would you explore next?

I?d really appreciate honest opinions, even if the answer is completely different from what I?ve been doing so far. @followers @highlight Upwork
